questions.question_text: A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
questions.explanation: The minute hand is at 15 minutes (90 degrees). The hour hand moves past the 3 by (15/60)*30 degrees = 7.5 degrees. Difference = 97.5 - 90 = 7.5.
